# mesa-mcp documentation

> mesa-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the CyVerse Data Store (iRODS) that adds ontology-driven AVU metadata from the EMBL-EBI Ontology Lookup Service, DataCite records, and a per-project AVU history kept by mesa-ducklake. The documentation covers installing and configuring mesa-mcp (local stdio, CyVerse VICE apps, and a hosted HTTP service behind CyVerse Keycloak), its 52 built-in tools, metadata workflows (AVU search, ontology terms, DataCite, tickets, AVU history and time travel), and how the code is built, tested, and extended. The source repository is an Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle: every page carries YAML frontmatter with type, provenance (generated/sources), and lifecycle (status/stale_after) fields.

Every page below is listed with three addresses that all return the same content: the rendered HTML page, its Markdown twin (page URL + `index.md`, served as text/markdown with the OKF frontmatter), and the raw source file on GitHub. Fetch whichever your tool is allowed to reach; many sandboxes permit github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com but not *.github.io.

```
Site page        https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/<path>/
Markdown twin    https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/<path>/index.md
Raw source       https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/<path>.md      (branch main; a moving target)

Content page     /user/getting-started/  ->  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/getting-started.md
```

The legacy form https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/<path>.md also still returns the same Markdown, for links made before 2026-09-10.

## Overview

- [mesa-mcp](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/): mesa-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the CyVerse Data Store (iRODS) that adds ontology-driven AVU metadata from the EMBL-EBI Ontology Lookup Service, DataCite records, and a per-project AVU history kept by mesa-ducklake. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/index.md

## Use mesa-mcp

- [Getting started](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/getting-started/): Choose a mesa-mcp deployment mode (local, CyVerse VICE app, or hosted), install locally in a minute, see the credential order at a glance, and what works without iRODS or the AVU history. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/getting-started/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/getting-started.md
- [Local install (Mode B)](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/local-install/): Install mesa-mcp in a virtualenv on Linux or macOS, supply iRODS credentials through environment variables, ~/.irods autodetection or YAML, smoke-test it with the MCP Inspector, and add the optional Croissant plugin. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/local-install/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/local-install.md
- [VICE app install (Mode C)](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/vice-apps/): Install and run mesa-mcp inside a CyVerse Discovery Environment VICE app (JupyterLab, RStudio Server, Cloud Shell), reusing the iRODS credentials the pod already has, and wire it into in-pod Claude Code. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/vice-apps/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/vice-apps.md
- [Connect to a hosted mesa-mcp](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/hosted-mcp/): Connect Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cline or Continue (through mcp-remote and a CyVerse Keycloak JWT) or a claude.ai custom connector to a hosted mesa-mcp over HTTP, verify the service with curl, and enroll a project for AVU history. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/hosted-mcp/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/hosted-mcp.md
- [MCP client wiring](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/claude-desktop/): JSON and CLI snippets for registering a local stdio mesa-mcp with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cline, Continue and the MCP Inspector, including an anonymous-only setup. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/claude-desktop/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/claude-desktop.md
- [Configuration](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/configuration/): Every mesa-mcp setting (irods, ols, ducklake, server) with its YAML key, MESA_MCP_* environment variable and default, the flag > env > YAML > default precedence, and how iRODS credentials are resolved. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/configuration/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/configuration.md
- [Tools reference](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/tools-reference/): Every one of the 52 built-in mesa-mcp tools (ds_*, mesa_ols_*, mesa_avu_*, mesa_datacite_*, mesa_ducklake_*, mesa_policy_*) with its description, input fields, defaults and notable outputs and errors, generated from the live tool registry. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/tools-reference/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/tools-reference.md
- [Metadata workflows](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/examples/): Worked tool-call sequences for finding files by AVU, tagging data with OLS ontology terms (unit = CURIE), bulk AVU writes, enrolling a project, reading AVU history and time travel, and using iRODS tickets with via_ticket provenance. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/examples/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/examples.md
- [DataCite metadata](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/datacite/): Write, check, and export DataCite 4.x descriptive metadata as iRODS AVUs with the four mesa_datacite_* and mesa_avu_apply_datacite tools, including the AVU naming scheme and how to produce DataCite XML for a DOI request. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/user/datacite/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/user/datacite.md

## Develop

- [Architecture](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/architecture/): How the mesa-mcp process is put together, from the CLI entry point through config, the tool registry and plugins, the stdio and HTTP transports, authentication, the iRODS pool, OLS, DataCite and DuckLake subsystems, and the error contract. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/architecture/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/dev/architecture.md
- [DuckLake integration](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/ducklake-integration/): How mesa-mcp uses mesa-ducklake in-process, how each AVU write is mirrored into the per-project history, and which history operations are MCP tools versus Python-API only. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/ducklake-integration/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/dev/ducklake-integration.md
- [Adding tools](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/adding-tools/): Step-by-step guide to adding an MCP tool to mesa-mcp with @register_tool (input and output models, auth_value, path checks, ToolError, the DuckLake mirror hook, tests), or shipping tools from another package through the mesa_mcp.tools entry point. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/adding-tools/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/dev/adding-tools.md
- [Testing](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/testing/): How to run mesa-mcp's hermetic pytest suite and linters, the test layout and fixtures, how iRODS, OLS and mesa-ducklake are mocked, and what each CI job (tests on Python 3.11-3.13, DuckLake integration, MCP 2026-07-28 conformance, docs) checks. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/testing/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/dev/testing.md
- [Contributing](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/contributing/): How to land a change in mesa-mcp: branch and PR conventions, pre-flight checks, the three Claude Code sub-agents, security rules, and how to edit, validate and publish these OKF docs. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/contributing/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/dev/contributing.md
- [Porting from Go](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/porting-from-go/): Cookbook for porting a ds_* tool from the Go cyverse/irods-mcp-server so names, input schemas and output shapes match byte for byte, with the go-irodsclient to python-irodsclient translation table and a worked example. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/porting-from-go/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/dev/porting-from-go.md
- [OLS internals](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/ols-internals/): The OLSClient wrapper (OLS4 endpoints, retries, seven TTL caches and the config that sets them), the frozen AVU contract shared with esiil-portal (attribute <ontology>.<snake_label>, unit = CURIE), round-trip invariants, and the error surface. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/dev/ols-internals/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/dev/ols-internals.md

## Deploy

- [Deployment overview](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/overview/): Topology and components of a hosted mesa-mcp (Mode A): a systemd service running the HTTP transport behind nginx and TLS, CyVerse Keycloak tokens, an optional Postgres catalog for AVU history, and the as-deployed VM. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/overview/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/deploy/overview.md
- [systemd](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/systemd/): A hardened systemd unit for running mesa-mcp's HTTP transport as a service, the install steps, what each directive does, the /healthz check, and log rotation. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/systemd/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/deploy/systemd.md
- [HTTP / SSE transport](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/http-sse/): The HTTP transport started with --transport sse: its routes (/sse, /messages/, /mcp, /healthz, RFC 9728 metadata), the bearer-token auth model, bind addresses, and an operator checklist. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/http-sse/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/deploy/http-sse.md
- [OIDC (CyVerse Keycloak)](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/oidc/): Register CyVerse Keycloak OIDC clients for mesa-mcp's HTTP transport, the config values to set, how tokens flow through mesa-mcp, and the request template for CyVerse IAM. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/oidc/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/deploy/oidc.md
- [Nginx + TLS](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/nginx-tls/): An nginx reverse-proxy configuration with Let's Encrypt TLS for mesa-mcp's SSE and Streamable HTTP endpoints, with the buffering and timeout settings streaming responses need. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/nginx-tls/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/deploy/nginx-tls.md
- [Postgres](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/postgres/): Provision a Postgres database for the mesa-ducklake catalog behind mesa-mcp's AVU history: role and database, migrations, the catalog_dsn, backups, and the DuckDB-file alternative. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/postgres/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/deploy/postgres.md
- [Monitoring](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/monitoring/): Where mesa-mcp's logs go and how to rotate them, what the /healthz endpoint reports, disk use, process supervision under systemd, and the absence of metrics. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/deploy/monitoring/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/deploy/monitoring.md

## Design records

- [DataCite support for mesa-mcp (design)](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/design/2026-06-08-datacite-support-design/): Design record approved 2026-06-08 for DataCite descriptive-metadata support: the gap it filled, mirroring the OLS pattern for a metadata standard, the schema, transform and tool components, validation and tests. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/design/2026-06-08-datacite-support-design/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/design/2026-06-08-datacite-support-design.md
- [DataCite support implementation plan](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/design/plans/2026-06-08-datacite-support/): Historical task-by-task plan (2026-06-08) that implemented the DataCite tools; its checkboxes are not maintained, so trust the code and tests over it. (deprecated; kept for history) Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/design/plans/2026-06-08-datacite-support/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/design/plans/2026-06-08-datacite-support.md

## About

- [For AI agents](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/about/ai-agents/): How AI agents should consume the mesa-mcp documentation (llms.txt, per-page Markdown with OKF frontmatter, raw GitHub sources, trust signals) and when to connect to mesa-mcp and call its tools instead of reading prose. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/about/ai-agents/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp/main/docs/about/ai-agents.md

## Meta

- [Full corpus in one file](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/llms-full.txt): every page's Markdown with frontmatter, links made absolute; about 302 KB, roughly 77,000 tokens. Prefer it over fetching pages one at a time.
- [Documentation update log](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/log/): dated history of changes to this bundle.
- [For AI agents](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/about/ai-agents/): endpoints, trust signals, and what to do if you cannot fetch this site.
- [Sitemap](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/sitemap.xml) and [robots.txt](https://idss-mesa.github.io/mesa-mcp/robots.txt): crawlers honour only the origin https://idss-mesa.github.io/robots.txt, which is equally permissive.
- [MESA project site](https://idss-mesa.github.io/llms.txt): origin-level llms.txt indexing the MESA site, this documentation, and the MESA software repositories.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/idss-mesa/mesa-mcp): the bundle itself; `docs/` mirrors the site paths one to one.

If you want CyVerse data rather than documentation, install the MESA MCP servers (or connect to a hosted endpoint) and call their tools; the agent guide explains how.
